## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · head 40f5639b42 · card #38034 · area s2-ai · 2026-11-28T05:26Z

**L1 checklist** (no review face on this file list: this record is the review of record)
- **Shape and checks.** The head shows 47 success, 15 expected skip, 0 failed and 0 pending, and `mergeable_state` is clean. 16 files: the usage hook and the indicator in `ui/packages/app-shell` with their tests, two new console keys in each of the 11 `ui/packages/i18n` locale packs (zh-Hant generated), and a changeset. Not governed.
- **The hook reads `tiers` strictly.**
  - `parseUsage` copies `tiers` field by field into its declared shape. `personal` may be null, `notice` may be null, and `notice` carries exactly four strings.
  - A malformed `tiers` is dropped on its own and `{ pool, breakdown }` still stands, so the ring always renders.
  - An absent `tiers` reads exactly as before.
  - The tests cover all four of the card's cases (none, valid, `personal: null`, malformed), and the dev's ablation turned 4 of them red.
- **The popover.** When `tiers` is present it shows one row per tier: status word, used share as a percent (no token counts, D5), and that tier's own reset. These rows replace the pool's single used figure. The ring, the pool's status, its reset line and the CTA keep reading `pool`, which is the binding reading. A `personal: null` caller sees the team pool row only. `tiers.notice` is shown as a status line in the console's language: zh for every Chinese script, then ja, then es, otherwise en. Without `tiers`, the output is unchanged; a test pins this.
- **Premise.** The card said "`app-shell` only". The strings live in `ui/packages/i18n`, and key parity needs every locale pack. The claim records this correction; the goal is unchanged.
- **Declarations.** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, an `@object-ui/app-shell` / `@object-ui/i18n` changeset. `Fixes #38034` is right. The framework half has no reach until cloud PR #5163 ships the field, and until then it is a no-op (no `tiers`, no change).

Tier: S. Landing: ready and auto-merge in this stroke.
